newsitem.title: USA: Continental Homes says Q1 home orders fall.
newsitem.headline: Continental Homes says Q1 home orders fall.

text.p: Continental Homes Holding Corp said net new home orders for its first fiscal quarter ended August 31, fell to 1,076, 14 percent below last year's 1,284.
The total sales value of new orders dropped to $143.7 million from $166.2 million last year, the company said.

The company said most of the decline was attributable to a decrease in order activity in Phoenix, and was "the result of a very difficult comparison and not a significant deterioration in the market."
Continental Homes said it delivered 1,368 new homes in the first quarter, which is a "record." The increase came from the strength of new orders booked in the spring, the company said.
Backlog of sold but undelivered homes at August 31 rose 15 percent to 1,857 homes with a sales value of $269.3 million versus 1,748 homes with a value of $234.2 million.
